description: The document marks no member of a `SetSecurityGroupRules` rule required, but the API rejects a rule without `action`, `protocol`, `direction`, `ip_range` or `position`. Observed 2026-10-14: `PUT /instance/v1/zones/nl-ams-1/security_groups/{id}/rules` with a complete rule answered 404 for an unknown security group (validation passed); dropping one member at a time answered 400 `invalid_arguments` with `rules.0.<member>` / reason `required` / help_message `required key not provided` for each of those five. `id`, `dest_port_from`, `dest_port_to`, `editable` and `zone` were accepted when absent (`dest_port_to` alone, without `dest_port_from`, is a 400 constraint error, not a missing key).
